_note: Hand-picked key numbers and classification chains for stone pages. Every item carries proofs. A sheet proof must match a verified value or a verified quote in the stone sheet (checked by scripts/build-stone-extras.mjs). A page proof must appear in the page text (checked again at every build, so an item disappears when the page stops saying it). An item that fails a proof is dropped, a chain that fails one proof is dropped whole. Labels in Title Case, no colons, no middle dots.
